objective: Auditar exclusivamente en READ_ONLY el bootstrap del migration writer HUB_Escritura despues de MIGRATION_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED. Confirmar database user, authentication type, mapeo SID a server login si la metadata es visible, login disabled/enabled, y comparar con HRLectura. No leer password hashes, no probar credenciales, no cambiar principals, roles ni permisos, no tocar Production.

queries.name: database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: database_principals
queries.sql: SELECT name,type_desc,authentication_type_desc,default_schema_name FROM sys.database_principals WHERE name IN ('HRLectura','HUB_Escritura') ORDER BY name

queries.name: server_login_mapping
queries.sql: SELECT dp.name AS database_user,sp.name AS server_login,sp.type_desc AS server_type,sp.is_disabled FROM sys.database_principals dp LEFT JOIN sys.server_principals sp ON sp.sid=dp.sid WHERE dp.name IN ('HRLectura','HUB_Escritura') ORDER BY dp.name

queries.name: named_server_principals
queries.sql: SELECT name,type_desc,is_disabled FROM sys.server_principals WHERE name IN ('HRLectura','HUB_Escritura') ORDER BY name

queries.name: database_roles_snapshot
queries.sql: SELECT mp.name AS member_name,rp.name AS role_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals rp ON rp.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals mp ON mp.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE mp.name IN ('HRLectura','HUB_Escritura') ORDER BY mp.name,rp.name
